K± and ϯ meson production in pA collisions are sensitive to the properties of the mesons in nuclear matter.

we have shown that the strangeness transfer mechanism is essential for K± and ϔ production in pA collisions, and the target mass dependence of K± production is predicted to be a sensitive probe for the in-medium properties.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the production of K± in pA collisions at SIS energies is dominated by nucleon-hyperons channels, while ϕ production is dominated by nucleonic channels.
the production of K+ and K− in pA collisions is dominated by the nucleon-hydrogen strangeness transfer channel.
the production of K± and the ϕ meson in pA collisions at the LHC energies is dominated by the strange baryon channel.
